video_title: Chandler - Lakers Look ELITE Without Luka! Austin Reaves Is An All-Star!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' balanced offensive performance and defensive effort against the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: This was a complete balanced attack and a dominating game by Austin Reaves
quotes.quote: This first quarter yesterday was insane. A lot of times when the opposing team sees the best player not playing, they take their foot off the gas. Guys stepped up. Williams stepped up, Colin Sexton stepped up. This was a complete balanced attack and a dominating game by Austin Reaves who was hitting the toughest shots. He was picking out guys like Kevin Huerter, getting a switch and then going directly at them. Quentin Grimes got in his bag a little bit. This was a nice little showcase game for them offensively. They have been much better defensively than I think anybody gave them credit for. When you look at the starting five with Walker Kessler, Luka, and Austin Reaves, that doesn't look like this elite defensive team, but then Thybull has been great, Sexton comes in, picks you up 94 feet, Jared Vanderbilt is like a switching one through five type of versatile guy. They do have the pieces and the assets.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' success and team identity without Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: We've seen Luka led teams in Dallas where you look around and you look at guys that's able to do their jobs
quotes.quote: We were surprised that they would be at the top of the West right now with all of the jokes that they were receiving coming into this season about the makeup of this team. But it's worked and we've seen this movie before. We've seen Luka led teams in Dallas where you look around and you look at guys that's able to do their jobs and do their parts and they give themselves an opportunity to win basketball games. And then when they go out, Austin Reaves steps in and he has a big night. That's why you move pieces around to allow these guys to be in the positions that they're in without looking over their shoulders and it's been able to work and it's been able to work well.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' depth and talent shining in the absence of Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: The absence of Luka gave an opportunity to really show the talent that's around him with this group
quotes.quote: The absence of Luka gave an opportunity to really show the talent that's around him with this group. Obviously Luka is such a ball dominant player that he kind of takes away from the other guys' opportunities. So last night you really got to see the talent be on display. Quentin Grimes being able to get in his bag the way he did, Zaire Williams coming off the bench shooting at a high clip. Obviously the story of the night is Austin Reaves putting on an incredible performance last night. This group has a lot of talent that was kind of hidden with the dominance of Luka, but this team is shaping out to be pretty damn good.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's historic scoring run and MVP-level performance
quotes.excerpt: The run he's on is historic and it's crazy because if you look at Kobe's run in 2003

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: The run that Luka is on is historic and it's crazy because if you look at Kobe's run in 2003, the numbers are almost identical, honestly. They're averaging 44, eight rebounds and eight assists. His performance so far early in the season, 52, 41, 37, 45, 42, 40 and 53. That is insane to say out loud.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Those Kobe numbers too down there are pretty impressive and I feel like Luka has been on heaters like this before. It's just magnified right now because they're the shocking team. They're nine and two, they sit at the top of the Western Conference with a really loaded group. This team is the best team in the Western Conference right now and obviously has a lot to do with him and the way he's scoring the ball. 48 and eight on an average, he makes it look so easy. You can't speed him up. That left step back has just continued to be absolutely unstoppable and you can't guard it.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's commitment to winning and MVP candidacy
quotes.excerpt: I don't want to hear any more excuses as to why he can't be an MVP
quotes.quote: He's showing that he's committed to winning. He's showing that he's committed to competing for a championship for this Lakers organization. He's leading by example and every knock that we ever had against him, he's checked those boxes as of right now. I don't want to hear any more excuses as to why he can't be an MVP. This guy should be, as of right now and moving forward, he should be one of the top names in discussion for the award. He's showing it every night.
